river.name: ZORA'S RIVER
river.arrival: White water tumbles out of the mountain. Follow the banks and bridges to the royal crest beneath the great waterfall.

people.name: Bean Seller
lines: The Zoras hear the river differently from us. Their waterfall listens for a song from the royal family.
Cold water carries you downstream. Swim toward the sloping banks if you need a place to climb out.

people.name: River Watcher
lines: Our princess is missing. King Zora has hardly left his throne. Follow the water home, traveler.
Water can hide a road as easily as stone. Look beneath the surface after earning a diver's scale.

domain.name: ZORA'S DOMAIN
domain.arrival: Cool pools catch the light beneath a vaulted cavern. A diving master watches the water, while King Zora waits on the high northern throne.

people.name: Diving Master
lines: A breath, a leap, and an eye for the glint below.

people.name: Pool Keeper
lines: Our diving master will teach you to reach deeper water. Collect all five blue rupees, then return to him for the Silver Scale.
The shallow spring beside me is full of fish. An empty bottle and a quick hand are all you need.

lake.name: LAKE HYLIA
lake.arrival: The river opens into a wide basin ringed by wooded stone shores. The laboratory and fishing hut mark the banks. A bottle glints below, near an old submerged arch.

people.name: Lake Scientist
lines: I keep a record of the lake's rise and fall. Someone dropped a bottle near the tunnel in the northwestern shallows. It sank deeper than an ordinary diver can reach.
A Silver Scale is a promise from the Zoras: you have learned to trust your breath, and to return before it fails.

people.name: Fisherman
lines: The large fish wait for patience, not noise. For now, the little fish near the Domain are easier to scoop into a bottle.

fountain.name: ZORA'S FOUNTAIN
fountain.arrival: An immense guardian rests in the sacred spring. His gills rise with each slow breath, but a sickly shiver passes along his back.

people.name: Shrine Keeper
lines: Lord Jabu-Jabu has refused his food. Princess Ruto used to bring a fresh fish every morning. Perhaps he will open his mouth for one.
We heard a terrible humming inside him. Please find our princess and bring her home.
